title: per-lane-coalescer-and-smoothscale-fuse-int8-paths
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: short-sequence INT8 workloads (chat snippets, low-context queries) were showing suboptimal vector unit utilization and extra memory traffic due to per-token misalignment and an extra dequant/rescale op introduced by the smoothquant-style preprocessing. This PR introduces a per-token "token-lane coalescer" tiling strategy together with a fused lightweight lane re-scaler ("smoothscale") that folds into the dequant path to eliminate an intermediate kernel launch. The work targets the runtime kernel layer and scheduler hints so the continuous batching subsystem can coalesce token lanes before packing, and the KV packer aligns INT8 KV blocks to 128B boundaries to avoid unaligned device loads. Key outcomes: +18% steady-state throughput on A100 for short (<=64) sequences on our internal int8-Llama-like model, 6–12% reduction in tail latency P95, and peak memory bandwidth savings that reduce overall token cost. Approach: 1) Add token-lane tiler kernel that groups tokens across requests into per-lane chunks to improve SIMD utilization; 2) Implement smoothscale fusion inside the int8 dequant kernel (single combined pass) rather than a separate op; 3) Update kv_packer to emit aligned strides and expose an alignment-aware load codepath in the int8 kernels; 4) Add scheduler hints to continuous_batcher so batcher prefers coalescing lanes when sequence histogram indicates many short requests; 5) Provide runtime feature flag and canary rollout path for Dedicated clusters. Compatibility: runtime exposes both legacy and fused paths behind a dynamic feature flag; fallback to legacy path if kernel not available or alignment mismatch occurs. Tests & safety: unit tests for numerical equivalence within epsilon on validation prompt sets, perf benchmarks in CI (short/medium/long histograms), and a staged canary rollout (10% capacity) before full merge. Related Linear tasks: ENG-4821, ENG-4867. Checklist: [x] kernel implementation [x] scheduler hint [x] kv packer alignment [x] tests & perf harness [x] docs note [x] canary rollout plan. Links: design doc (internal): /docs/design/int8-token-lane-coalescer.md, perf run: internal.perf/243501, linear: ENG-4821.

benchmark_summary: Short sequences (<=64 tokens): +18% throughput, P95 latency -8ms; Medium (65-256): neutral to +2% depending on histogram; Long (>256): no change. Memory bandwidth reduced by ~9% on observed kernels. CI perf runs attached: internal.perf/243501/results.json
rollout_plan: Feature gated; canary to 10% of Dedicated capacity for 48h with perf and correctness guardrails; if stable, increase to 50% for 72h then full enable. Automatic rollback if numerical regression >1e-3 or throughput regression >3% on canary traces.
notes: This PR was intentionally conservative about FP8 path interaction — the fused kernel supports a flag-driven scale-flow compatible with both INT8 and FP8 microkernels. Future work: investigate cross-request KV packing to further reduce loads for microbatching scenarios.
